Set exact advertising copy, then change weather in a follow-up edit.

**Original prompt · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Upload the shampoo photograph linked below, or your own product photograph.
- Step 2 edits the output of step 1. Keep the image in the same conversation or upload it again.

Source reference images: [1](https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/shampoo.webp)

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>

#### Step 1

```text
Create a realistic billboard mockup of the shampoo on a highway scene during sunset.
Billboard text (EXACT, verbatim, no extra characters):
"Fresh and clean"
Typography: bold sans-serif, high contrast, centered, clean kerning.
Ensure text appears once and is perfectly legible.
No watermarks, no logos.
```

#### Step 2

```text
Make it look like a winter evening with snowfall.
```

[Browse the online gallery](https://image-2-5.com/gpt-image-2-5-prompts?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=detail--en--billboard-seasonal-iteration)

</details>

### Make it your own

Follow the steps in order. Reuse prior outputs where required and check external processing before starting.

### Notes

- Keep "Fresh and clean" in English in every language. Compare wording and billboard geometry after the winter edit.
- Source settings: `size="1024x1536"`, `quality="medium"`.

先指定精确广告文字，再通过后续编辑改变天气。

**原始提示词 · 多步骤工作流 · 尚未独立测试**

### 输入要求

- 上传下方洗发水照片，或自己的产品照片。
- 第 2 步编辑第 1 步的结果。保留同一对话中的图像，或再次上传该图。

来源参考图: [1](https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/shampoo.webp)

<details>
<summary>提示词</summary>

#### 步骤 1

```text
制作一张真实的洗发水广告牌样机，置于日落时的公路场景中。
广告牌文字（精确、逐字、不加任何字符）：
"Fresh and clean"
排版：粗体无衬线、高对比、居中、字距整洁。
确保文字只出现一次，并且完全清晰可读。
不要水印，不要标志。
```

#### 步骤 2

```text
让它呈现下雪的冬日傍晚景象。
```

</details>

### 改成你的需求

按顺序执行步骤，按要求复用先前结果，开始前确认外部处理工具可用。

### 使用说明

- 所有语言版本都保留英文 "Fresh and clean"。冬景编辑后对照检查文字与广告牌几何形状。
- 来源参数：`size="1024x1536"`, `quality="medium"`.
